title: atuna elliptica
intro: Atuna elliptica, commonly known as the Borneo ironwood, is a tropical tree species native to Borneo. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to provide health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Atuna elliptica are primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the bioactive constituents of Atuna elliptica have been found to possess analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-haemorrhagic effects, contributing to its traditional use in folk medicine for various ailments.
